items.title: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies (WAB) Is Up 16.7% After Buyback-Fueled EPS Lift And Dividend Affirmation

The combination of earnings growth, continued capital returns through buybacks and dividends, and improved per-share profitability offers fresh context for how investors may view Wabtec’s rail-focused business model.
